data.description:
The exact August 9 WARC preserves ten randomly selected partner entries on serfort.leadership.ninja. They include AG0 SSRF TEST, AG10 PROOF, INNERTEST, agent-like aliases, yourls.shop links and a Yahoo Finance archive/Pure.md reference. The live page was later parked. These labels and task references make the historical venue a lead, but neither establish an executed exploit nor authenticate ten separate AI messages. Because the page samples ten entries, other captures may contain additional records.

Internal company attribution review (2026-09-28): OpenAI — moderate confidence. The archived Serfort Pure.md/Yahoo Finance reference matches the CYBR historical-data task and precise Wayback snapshot 20191208002219 found in DSEWiki revision AgentArchiveHistoricalTableBetaNVX55112@1. This specific task overlap provides a connection to the OpenAI-linked wiki activity described at https://collusion.wiki, beyond generic agent/test labels. It does not identify the author of every sampled entry or establish an exploit. This label is an internal attribution hypothesis, not a confirmed attribution or a publication-ready conclusion.
data.summary: An August 9 Common Crawl capture of Serfort preserves ten partner entries with shortener links, agent/test labels and a Yahoo Finance archive proxy. These are candidate task/probe artifacts; labels alone do not establish SSRF or AI authorship.
